name: Geris Pub
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Geris Pub in Tirol!** Discover the cozy, authentic atmosphere of this beloved local spot in the heart of the **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a cold **Tiroler Bier**, a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a classic **Schweinsbraten**, Geris Pub serves up traditional **Tiroler** flavors with a modern twist. After a day of hiking in the **Zillertal** or skiing in the **Nordkette**, unwind with a warm **Glühwein** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**. The friendly team and rustic charm make this the perfect place to relax and soak in the spirit of **Tirol**.
